questions.question: Which mobile features are in scope for the first release? Confirm or refine: member/admin roles; profiles and Elo; session scheduling; live scores; matchmaking that balances skill (1–4), repeat pairings, and rest; weighted bills and late fees; VietQR links/images; head-to-head stats; and on-device shuttle tracking with camera/OpenCV/TFLite. Should camera tracking be advisory with manual correction, or authoritative for scores?
questions.answer: Camera tracking and speed estimation are advisory/entertainment only. Scores are manually controlled via screen taps or smartwatch remote, with manual correction allowed at any time.
questions.rationale: The feature set is stated, but scope priority and whether computer vision can authoritatively update scores are unresolved.
questions.recommendedChoice: All listed features; CV-generated scores are advisory and can be corrected manually.

questions.question: Confirm backend responsibilities and data/security rules: Supabase Auth, Postgres schema and row-level security, Realtime subscriptions, Storage, role permissions, and any Edge Functions. Who can create/edit sessions, approve payments, set Elo, and alter charges?
questions.answer: Role-based security (Admin vs Member). Only Admin can create/edit sessions, input shuttlecock counts, alter charges, approve payment status, and modify member ratings. Members have read-only access to group sessions, live scoreboard, and personal bills, with permission to update their own profile and attendance status.
questions.rationale: The requested Supabase capabilities are known, but membership/admin policy and trusted computation boundaries need confirmation.
questions.recommendedChoice: Use Supabase Auth + PostgreSQL/RLS + Realtime + Storage; restrict admin actions to admins; no client-side trust for payment approval, Elo changes, or bill totals.

questions.question: Which VietQR/payment flow is intended: display a static/dynamic bank-transfer QR with payer reference and manual admin approval, or integrate a bank/payment provider for automated payment status? Which bank/provider and required payment reference format?
questions.answer: Dynamic VietQR generated on client-side with Admin bank account, exact total amount, and transfer memo format 'CLB_{sessionId}_{memberId}'. Payment status is marked manually by Admin upon receiving bank notification.
questions.rationale: QR generation is requested, but the bank/provider, payment matching and verification method are unspecified.
questions.recommendedChoice: Generate VietQR payment instructions/QR and require Admin approval until a payment provider and webhook integration are selected.

questions.question: Confirm the match format and algorithm rules: players per side/court, how team skill should be balanced using levels 1–4 and/or Elo, what counts as a repeated pairing (partner, opponent, or both, and over what history window), and the rest-balancing priority. How should Admin edits interact with suggestions?
questions.answer: Format is Doubles (2 vs 2). Algorithm balances teams by minimizing total skill level delta (levels 1-4 plus Elo rating). Avoids repeating identical partners or opponents within the last 3 matches of the session. Highest priority is given to bench players with the longest rest duration. Admin can freely drag-and-drop to override match suggestions.
questions.rationale: The balancing goals are clear but their constraints and tie-breakers are not.
questions.recommendedChoice: Generate explainable suggestions that balance team skill, avoid recent repeated partners/opponents, and minimize rest inequality; Admin confirms or edits each match.

questions.question: Confirm session billing details: how court cost is split, shuttle consumption attribution, water/extras and late-fee rules, rounding/currency, when attendance is full/half, and what happens to absent/cancelled players. Is the stated 1.0/0.5 attendance weight applied to the complete shared bill or only selected components?
questions.answer: Shared court fee is weighted by attendance (1.0 for full session, 0.5 for late/early departure). Shuttlecock fee = (shuttles used * unit price) divided evenly among players. Individual late-penalty fees and drinks are added directly to the individual's bill. Currency rounded to nearest 1,000 VND. Absent players pay 0 unless flagged by Admin.
questions.rationale: The bill components and weights are specified, but allocation details and edge cases are unresolved.
questions.recommendedChoice: Apply the confirmed attendance weight to shared session charges, define component-specific exceptions explicitly, and show an itemized bill with auditable rounding.

questions.question: Confirm expected squad size and concurrent courts/sessions, whether multiple admins are needed, target launch platforms (Android/iOS/both), and whether the app must work offline or under unreliable court connectivity.
questions.answer: Squad size is 8–25 active members, operating 1–3 concurrent courts per session. Support multiple co-admins. Target platforms are both iOS and Android. The app must support offline-first capability with local caching so that matchmaking, live scoring, and camera features run smoothly under unstable court Wi-Fi/4G, then automatically sync data to Supabase once internet connectivity is restored.
questions.rationale: These operational constraints affect schema, realtime behavior, and mobile testing but were not specified.
questions.recommendedChoice: Private invite-only squad, role-based admin access, Android and iOS, graceful reconnect for live scores; confirm offline-write requirements.
